preamble: Devoicing of the voiced aspirated (breathy-voiced) stop [dʱ] to the voiceless aspirated [tʰ] keeps the aspiration while losing voicing. It is the regular Greek reflex of Proto-Indo-European *dʰ (Greek θ, originally [tʰ]) and recurs independently in Romani, where Old Indo-Aryan voiced aspirates bh, dh, gh became ph, th, kh.

examples.note: Via Proto-Hellenic *tʰūmós; cf. Sanskrit dhūmá 'smoke', Latin fūmus.
Via Proto-Hellenic *títʰēmi; both *dʰ devoice to tʰ (the first then dissimilates by Grassmann's law); cf. Sanskrit dadhāti.
Romani devoiced the Old Indo-Aryan voiced aspirates (bh dh gh > ph th kh); cf. Hindi धूआँ dhūā̃.

sources: Wikipedia (2026). Romani language (Classification: devoicing of voiced aspirates bh dh gh > ph th kh). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romani_language
